description.text: Perfect Battle Deck 60: Zygarde-EX, a ready-built 60-card Fighting deck released on 18 March 2016 together with the M Audino-EX Mega Battle Deck. It gave Zygarde its first card, in its Complete Forme (Perfect Forme in Japanese), a Fighting-type Pokémon-EX with 190 HP. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a rule book and a player's guide came with it.
